This change ensures that the code remains functional without requiring modifications to the continuous-ingest scripts, as the new method is directly invoked in place of the removed utility class. The changes in `ContinuousMoru` and `RunTests` reflect this new approach by calling the `increment` method from `ContinuousVerify` instead of the now-removed `CounterUtils`.
